title: Depth-size circuit class
statement: Let $n$, $d$, and $s$ be natural numbers. The depth-size circuit class on $n$ coordinates consists of the Boolean functions for which there exists a width parameter such that the function has a depth-circuit representation with parameters $d$, $s$, and that width.
